name: 5dive-laya
description: The 5dive Laya plugin, published from its own repository: a local model as the provider behind `5dive reflex`.

plugins.name: laya
plugins.description: Run Laya, a small local typed-decision model, as the provider for `5dive reflex`, so reflex decides on your own box with no API key. One loopback-only service per host. Needs Starter Plus (8 GB) or larger.
